format: 24 kHz mono PCM16, generated offline at build-authoring time; no runtime TTS or download

lines.speaker: ops
lines.text: Supersonic speed reached.
lines.render_text: Supersonic speed reached.

lines.speaker: command
lines.text: Combat runs in real time.
lines.render_text: Combat runs in real time.

lines.speaker: ops
lines.text: Runway overrun. Parking brake set.
lines.match: Autoland: stopped past the end of the runway - parking brake set
lines.render_text: Runway overrun. Parking brake set.

lines.speaker: ops
lines.text: Too much tailwind to stop safely. Going around.
lines.match: Autopilot: too much tailwind to stop on this runway - going around
lines.render_text: Too much tailwind to stop safely. Going around.

lines.speaker: ops
lines.text: The wind has shifted. Unable to autoland. Circling clear of terrain.
lines.match: Autopilot: the wind has shifted - unable to autoland at .+
lines.render_text: The wind has shifted. Unable to autoland. Circling clear of terrain.

lines.speaker: ops
lines.text: Unable to autoland. Holding clear of the ground. Check the flight display.
lines.render_text: Unable to autoland. Holding clear of the ground. Check the flight display.

lines.speaker: ops
lines.text: Autopilot unable. Check the flight display and maintain control.
lines.render_text: Autopilot unable. Check the flight display and maintain control.

lines.speaker: ops
lines.text: Autopilot disconnected. You have control.
lines.render_text: Autopilot disconnected. You have control.

lines.speaker: ops
lines.text: Power-off diversion. Gliding toward the selected runway.
lines.render_text: Power-off diversion. Gliding toward the selected runway.

lines.speaker: ops
lines.text: Autoland destination set. Check the selected airport and runway.
lines.render_text: Autoland destination set. Check the selected airport and runway.

lines.speaker: ops
lines.text: Engine running. Release the parking brake when ready.
lines.match: Engine running\. Release the parking brake with .+\.
lines.render_text: Engine running. Release the parking brake when ready.

lines.speaker: ops
lines.text: Engine stopped. Use your engine start control to restart.
lines.render_text: Engine stopped. Use your engine start control to restart.

lines.speaker: ops
lines.text: Hover throttle mode. Hold the throttle increase control for thrust. Release it to idle.
lines.render_text: Hover throttle mode. Hold the throttle increase control for thrust. Release it to idle.

lines.speaker: ops
lines.text: Time acceleration changed.
lines.render_text: Time acceleration changed.

lines.speaker: ops
lines.text: Formation run complete. Return to the assigned airport and land.
lines.render_text: Formation run complete. Return to the assigned airport and land.

lines.speaker: ops
lines.text: Test card complete. Signed off.
lines.render_text: Test card complete. Signed off.

lines.speaker: ops
lines.text: Test complete. The result could not be saved. This sign-off is for this session only.
lines.match: TEST CARD .+ COMPLETE - SIGNED OFF THIS SESSION ONLY: THE RECORD COULD NOT BE SAVED
lines.render_text: Test complete. The result could not be saved. This sign-off is for this session only.

lines.speaker: ops
lines.text: Flap asymmetry. Match the flap lever to the stuck left flap. Use aileron to hold the wing up.
lines.match: FLAP ASYMMETRY  left stuck at [0-9]+%: keep the lever there
lines.render_text: Flap asymmetry. Match the flap lever to the stuck left flap. Use aileron to hold the wing up.

lines.speaker: ops
lines.text: Below minimums and not aligned. Go around.
lines.match: Below minimums and not lined up - GO AROUND
lines.render_text: Below minimums and not aligned. Go around.

lines.speaker: ops
lines.text: Gear cannot move. Check the landing gear warning.
lines.match: Gear won't (come down - it's stuck up|retract - it's stuck down)
lines.render_text: Gear cannot move. Check the landing gear warning.

lines.speaker: ops
lines.text: Already airborne. You are free to explore. Return from the pause menu when finished.
lines.match: Already airborne\. Fly anywhere, then return from the pause menu\.
lines.render_text: Already airborne. You are free to explore. Return from the pause menu when finished.

lines.speaker: ops
lines.text: Full tanks. Release the parking brake when ready.
lines.match: Full tanks\. Release the parking brake when ready\.
lines.render_text: Full tanks. Release the parking brake when ready.

lines.speaker: ops
lines.text: Destination region reached. Choose a local airport on the GPS map.
lines.match: Destination region reached\. Choose a local airport on the GPS map\.
lines.render_text: Destination region reached. Choose a local airport on the GPS map.

lines.speaker: ops
lines.text: Route set. Check your destination on the GPS map.
lines.match: .+ route set\. Nearby regions prepare in the background as you fly\.
lines.render_text: Route set. Check your destination on the GPS map.

lines.speaker: ops
lines.text: This route exceeds the aircraft's nominal fuel range. Choose a closer fuel stop.
lines.match: Route exceeds nominal fuel range\. Choose a closer stop or a longer-range aircraft\.
lines.render_text: This route exceeds the aircraft's nominal fuel range. Choose a closer fuel stop.

lines.speaker: ops
lines.text: Entering the next region.
lines.render_text: Entering the next region.

lines.speaker: command
lines.text: Military aircraft assigned. Complete the objectives, then return to extraction.
lines.match: MILITARY LOANER / return to extraction after objectives
lines.render_text: Military aircraft assigned. Complete the objectives, then return to extraction.

lines.speaker: command
lines.text: Proceed to the first marked intelligence site. Maintain the sensor altitude and speed.
lines.render_text: Proceed to the first marked intelligence site. Maintain the sensor altitude and speed.

lines.speaker: command
lines.text: Protect the marked site. Keep hostile aircraft away from the objective.
lines.render_text: Protect the marked site. Keep hostile aircraft away from the objective.

lines.speaker: command
lines.text: Practice wave deployed. Enemy contacts are marked.
lines.render_text: Practice wave deployed. Enemy contacts are marked.

lines.speaker: command
lines.text: Intelligence site recorded.
lines.render_text: Intelligence site recorded.

lines.speaker: command
lines.text: Incoming fire. Break away.
lines.render_text: Incoming fire. Break away.

lines.speaker: command
lines.text: The protected site is under attack.
lines.render_text: The protected site is under attack.

lines.speaker: command
lines.text: Hostile wave inbound.
lines.render_text: Hostile wave inbound.

lines.speaker: command
lines.text: Objectives complete. Return to extraction.
lines.render_text: Objectives complete. Return to extraction.

lines.speaker: command
lines.text: All military objectives are secure. Mission complete.
lines.render_text: All military objectives are secure. Mission complete.

lines.speaker: command
lines.text: Military objective lost. Mission unsuccessful.
lines.render_text: Military objective lost. Mission unsuccessful.

lines.speaker: command
lines.text: Aircraft destroyed by enemy fire.
lines.render_text: Aircraft destroyed by enemy fire.

lines.speaker: ops
lines.text: Free flight complete.
lines.render_text: Free flight complete.

lines.speaker: ops
lines.text: Practice flight complete.
lines.render_text: Practice flight complete.

lines.speaker: ops
lines.text: Practice flight ended.
lines.render_text: Practice flight ended.

lines.speaker: ops
lines.text: Research flight complete.
lines.render_text: Research flight complete.

lines.speaker: ops
lines.text: Checkride not passed. Review the debrief before trying again.
lines.render_text: Checkride not passed. Review the debrief before trying again.

lines.speaker: ops
lines.text: Flight complete. Review your landing and flight results.
lines.render_text: Flight complete. Review your landing and flight results.

lines.speaker: ops
lines.text: Flight ended after impact. Review the debrief when ready.
lines.render_text: Flight ended after impact. Review the debrief when ready.

lines.speaker: ops
lines.text: Flight ended. Review the debrief when ready.
lines.render_text: Flight ended. Review the debrief when ready.

lines.speaker: ops
lines.text: Autopilot route updated. Check the selected runway on the flight display.
lines.render_text: Autopilot route updated. Check the selected runway on the flight display.

lines.speaker: ops
lines.text: Destination region reached. Local airport data is still preparing.
lines.match: Destination region reached\. Local airports remain unavailable while detailed terrain prepares\.
lines.render_text: Destination region reached. Local airport data is still preparing.

lines.speaker: command
lines.text: Plasma bomb released.
lines.render_text: Plasma bomb released.

lines.speaker: command
lines.text: Penetrator released.
lines.render_text: Penetrator released.

lines.speaker: command
lines.text: Electromagnetic pulse payload released.
lines.render_text: Electromagnetic pulse payload released.

lines.speaker: command
lines.text: Structure destroyed.
lines.render_text: Structure destroyed.

lines.speaker: command
lines.text: Weapons overheated. Allow them to cool.
lines.render_text: Weapons overheated. Allow them to cool.

lines.speaker: command
lines.text: Forward weapon ammunition depleted.
lines.render_text: Forward weapon ammunition depleted.

lines.speaker: ops
lines.text: Tilt the four thruster pods fully down for vertical takeoff. Use the flap controls shown on screen.
lines.match: .+: tilt the four thruster pods fully down for vertical takeoff
lines.render_text: Tilt the four thruster pods fully down for vertical takeoff. Use the flap controls shown on screen.

lines.speaker: ops
lines.text: Good decision going around. Set up on the centreline, at approach speed, before trying again.
lines.render_text: Good decision going around. Set up on the centreline, at approach speed, before trying again.

lines.speaker: ops
lines.text: Touchdown was firm. Hold a steady descent on power, then gently raise the nose to flare just above the runway.
lines.render_text: Touchdown was firm. Hold a steady descent on power, then gently raise the nose to flare just above the runway.

lines.speaker: ops
lines.text: Your threshold speed was too high. Slow down earlier on final. Extra speed causes floating and uses more runway.
lines.render_text: Your threshold speed was too high. Slow down earlier on final. Extra speed causes floating and uses more runway.

lines.speaker: ops
lines.text: The touchdown point was beyond the middle of the runway. On your next approach, use the first third of the runway.
lines.render_text: The touchdown point was beyond the middle of the runway. On your next approach, use the first third of the runway.

lines.speaker: ops
lines.text: Little runway remained after stopping. Brake firmly once all wheels are down.
lines.render_text: Little runway remained after stopping. Brake firmly once all wheels are down.

lines.speaker: ops
lines.text: You were too slow over the threshold. Keep the recommended approach speed until the flare.
lines.render_text: You were too slow over the threshold. Keep the recommended approach speed until the flare.

lines.speaker: ops
lines.text: Threshold height was excessive. Establish a three degree glide path earlier.
lines.render_text: Threshold height was excessive. Establish a three degree glide path earlier.

lines.speaker: ops
lines.text: Well flown. Your landing measurements are shown in the debrief.
lines.render_text: Well flown. Your landing measurements are shown in the debrief.
